item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"TASK.md\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,copy; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); before=copy.deepcopy((p,rs)); actual=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; expected=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); assert (p,rs)==before; assert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}; assert evaluate({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':99},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}; assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':True},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}; assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':2},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}; assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':1},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}; print('ok')\"]}}]}"}
